products.name: LMSYS Arena Models
products.note: Model evaluation platform; crowdsourced benchmarking; research transparency; no production use

profile_text.body:
LMSYS is a nonprofit organization that operates Lmarena.ai, a public platform described on its own site as an AI ranking and LLM leaderboard. The site invites users to chat with, compare, and vote on AI models across text, image, and code categories, with the stated aim of supporting community-driven, real-world evaluation that shapes a public leaderboard. The site also notes that user conversations and certain other personal information may be disclosed to relevant AI providers and may be made public to support the community and advance AI research.

The organization's tracked product, listed under the category of Chat and General LLMs, is the LMSYS Arena Models platform, characterized as a model evaluation platform built around crowdsourced benchmarking and research transparency, with no production use. No litigation, patent filings, SEC disclosures, or MCP server registrations are on record for the organization.
